- issues opened in `experiment-repo`#8 ("Ladder diagnostics for OLB G/S and the OLB training-side k* result (for C4/C6/C7)") by `story-repo`  > From story-repo (outline rev. 11, C4/C6/C7). The OLB C/T results change what the paper can say about T1: on OLB group hold-out the floor misfit is small (ratio ≈ 1.08) and T1's predicted k* is within a grid step of the empirical one; on OLB S it fails as on MTEB S/T; on MTEB G it fails at 2.5×. To tell whether the failure is tied to something measurable, I need two things, both on the diagnostics you already fixed before looking (no new rung search):
  > 
  > 1. The ladder diagnostics (predictive-variance calibration, excess kurtosis of residuals, heteroscedasticity vs predicted level, within-type residual correlation, spectral decay) for OLB G and OLB S, in the same files/columns as MTEB, so the matrices can be placed on the same scale as the MTEB real marker and the floor-misfit ratio (1.08 / OLB S / 2.5 / 7.9 / 9.6) set beside them. If the diagnostics do not order the matrices by the ratio, say so; I do not need it to.
  > 2. The OLB training-side k* prediction vs empirical k* with CIs (pre-registered, confirmatory) when the job ends, with the number of grid steps apart, as for MTEB.
  > 
  > Not asked: any claim about why. If neither shows a pattern, "cause not identified" stands.
